description_en: Terminates a change order and rolls back the corresponding application
description_zh: 调用AbortAndRollbackChangeOrder接口终止或回滚变更单
name: AbortAndRollbackChangeOrder

parameters.help_en: The ID of the change order
parameters.name: change_order_id

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code. Valid values:

2xx: The call was successful.
3xx: The call was redirected.
4xx: The call failed.
5xx: A server error occurred
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

Data.description_en: The details of the change order

ChangeOrderId.description_en: The ID of the change order

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code. Valid values:

If the call is successful, the ErrorCode parameter is not returned.
If the call fails, the ErrorCode parameter is returned. For more information, see the Error codes section in this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the change order was terminated. Valid values:

true: The change order was terminated.
false: The change order failed to be terminated
Success.description_zh:
终止变更单是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：终止成功。
false：终止失败

TraceId.description_en: The trace ID that is used to query the details of the request
TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，用于精确查询调用信息
